subject: Insurer endorsement sequencing & carrier contact for Nimbus onboarding
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.example.com>
To: Allied Brokers <brokers@alliedexample.com>, Nimbus Legal <legal@nimbuscloud.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.example.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Insurer endorsement sequencing & carrier contact for Nimbus onboarding

Hi Sam / Nimbus team,

Quick summary: Nimbus' procurement has asked for the Additional Insured endorsement and waiver of subrogation to be reflected on the Order Form before we can finalize the onboarding. Pls see attached Order Form that we'll execute (orderform_redline.pdf) — the legal redline already calls for:
- Additional Insured: Redwood Inference and its affiliates
- Waiver of Subrogation in favor of Redwood
- Coverage minimums: CGL 1M/2M, Auto 1M, Cyber 5M (we can adjust if your broker confirms different minimums)

Questions we need answered to close this:
1) Can the insurer issue an ISO endorsement or do you expect carrier-specific language?
2) Can we accept a scanned PDF of the signed endorsement (time-sensitive) or do we need an embossed/original signed endorsement?
3) If the endorsement will be delayed beyond the execution date, can the carrier provide a binder letter or "proof of pending endorsement" (dated and on carrier letterhead) we can accept temporarily?
4) Expected timeline to issue the endorsement and whether there's a policy number we can reference now.

If it helps, we are open to a short, temporary exception in the Order Form that requires the endorsement to be delivered within 30 days of execution, along with a binder if endorsement issuance will take longer. Aditya, can you confirm this approach is acceptable from the commercial side?

Thanks — attaching the order form redline.

--
Kimberly Park
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.example.com

Attachment: orderform_redline.pdf (Order Form redline, 4 pages)
From: Sam Hollis <brokers@alliedexample.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Nimbus Legal <legal@nimbuscloud.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.example.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 14:12:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Insurer endorsement sequencing & carrier contact for Nimbus onboarding

Kimberly,

Thanks — quick update from the broker side. I spoke with the primary carrier (GreatHearth Ins Co) and here is what they said: 
- They can issue an Additional Insured endorsement naming "Redwood Inference, its subsidiaries and affiliates" and include Waiver of Subrogation, but the endorsement needs to be cut on carrier stationery and signed by an underwriter.
- Standard turnaround is 7-10 business days once we provide the fully executed Order Form and the policy number (if available). If the policy is not yet active, they can issue a binder letter on carrier letterhead confirming coverage and that endorsement will follow within 30 days.
- Scanned signed endorsements are acceptable for onboarding in most cases; the carrier will provide a signed PDF. If Nimbus requires the original we can follow up, but that typically slows things down and is rare.

I'm attaching a sample binder letter we can provide immediately as interim proof (binder-letter.pdf). If you want carrier-specific endorsement text for your legal team to review, I can request a draft endorsement from GreatHearth and share as soon as it's available.

Action items I propose:
1) Kimberly / Redwood: confirm whether a signed PDF endorsement + binder (if needed) is acceptable as interim evidence.
2) Nimbus: confirm whether the scanned signed endorsement is sufficient or if you require originals.
3) Once the Order Form is countersigned, Allied will request the endorsement and push for the carrier draft ASAP.

Sam Hollis
Allied Brokers
sam.hollis@alliedexample.com

Attachment: binder-letter.pdf (Binder letter — provisional coverage confirmation)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.example.com>
To: Nimbus Legal <legal@nimbuscloud.com>, Allied Brokers <brokers@alliedexample.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.example.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Insurer endorsement sequencing & carrier contact for Nimbus onboarding

Thanks Sam — that binder sample is helpful. Nimbus, for procurement/legal clarity:
- We can accept a signed PDF endorsement plus a carrier binder as interim proof, provided the Order Form includes a delivery timeline (endorsement to be delivered within 30 days of execution).
- Required coverage minimums we are asking the carrier to confirm: CGL 1M/2M, Auto 1M, Cyber 5M. Please flag any deviations.
- We also need the policy number and effective dates noted in the binder if possible.

Aditya — please confirm commercially if Redwood can commit to the 30-day delivery timeline and interim binder approach. Also flag whether we should require the endorsement to name any additional entities (subsidiaries / AWS as subprocessor) beyond the standard Redwood naming.

Suggested Order Form language (temporary clause):
"Seller shall deliver to Buyer within thirty (30) days after the Effective Date evidence of the Additional Insured endorsement and any waivers of subrogation described herein. In the event the endorsement is not yet issued, Seller may provide a carrier binder letter that references the policy number and confirms the carrier's commitment to issue the endorsement within thirty (30) days."

I have a redline of the endorsement wording attached for legal review (endorsement-redline.docx).

--
Kim

Attachment: endorsement-redline.docx (Word document with suggested endorsement wording)
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.example.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.example.com>, Nimbus Legal <legal@nimbuscloud.com>
Cc: Allied Brokers <brokers@alliedexample.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2026 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Insurer endorsement sequencing & carrier contact for Nimbus onboarding

Kim — I'm fine with the 30-day delivery timeline and accepting a signed PDF endorsement + binder as interim evidence. A couple of commercial asks:
- Please ensure the binder explicitly lists the policy number and effective date range so procurement can track.
- If the carrier can confirm the endorsement will be backdated to the policy effective date, that's preferable.
- We should avoid naming cloud providers (e.g., AWS) as Additional Insured unless Nimbus requires it — that complicates things with many carriers.

If Nimbus confirms acceptance, Kimberly, please proceed to countersign the Order Form and share countersigned copy with Allied so they can request the endorsement.

Thanks,
Aditya
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
